title: The design app won't install
scenario: Ticket #4703 — Morgan (DESIGN-PC-11) starts on the design team on Monday and needs PlanPro Design 2026 to create and edit client drawings. Morgan says the installation keeps failing. The vendor's requirements are a 64-bit operating system, 16 GB of memory, a graphics card with at least 4 GB of video memory, and 12 GB of free storage. Company policy: software is installed only from the company software portal.
tasks: Find out what Morgan tried and check the PC against the vendor's requirements.
Clear whatever stands in the way of a safe installation without losing Morgan's files.
Install the edition of PlanPro that does the job, the way policy requires.
Prove PlanPro works before you close the ticket.
Tell Morgan what they need to know.

rows: Dedicated graphics card, 6 GB video memory

portal.label: PlanPro Viewer 2026 (free)
portal.desc: Opens and prints drawings. Cannot create or edit them.
portal.testFail: The drawing opened read-only. The Viewer cannot create or edit drawings.

portal.label: PlanPro Design 2026 (32-bit)
portal.warn: Setup note: the 32-bit edition can use at most 4 GB of memory.
portal.testFail: PlanPro: "Out of memory. This drawing is too large for the 32-bit edition."

user.name: Morgan
user.story: I found PlanPro on a free download site, but when I ran the installer it said the publisher was unknown, so I stopped and called you. Also, all my client drawings are in my Downloads folder, so please don't lose those.

advice.reply: Great. Next time I need something I'll just look on that download site again.

advice.text: "The download site's copy wasn't from the vendor and could have carried malware, so stopping was the right call. Work software comes from the company software portal; if what you need isn't there, ask IT. Also, your drawings are safer in Documents than in Downloads."
advice.short: explained the risk, the approved source and where to keep files
advice.reply: Thanks. I'll use the portal from now on and move my drawings to Documents.

advice.text: "Downloading software is against policy. Don't do it again."
advice.reply: Sorry. I was only trying to get ready for Monday.

hints: Ask Morgan what happened, then compare System Information with the vendor's requirements in the ticket.
The PC meets the processor, memory and graphics requirements. One requirement is not met yet.
Disk Cleanup can free space, but read each item. One of them deletes files Morgan needs.
Policy says where software comes from. The downloaded installer is from an unknown publisher; do not run it.
The portal offers three versions. Only one can create and edit drawings on this 64-bit PC without running out of memory.
Open PlanPro with a sample drawing to prove it works, then brief Morgan.

checks.label: Checked the PC against the vendor's requirements before changing anything
checks.pass: You compared System Information with the requirements before acting.
checks.fail: You made a change before checking System Information against the vendor's requirements, so you could not know what was blocking the install.

checks.label: Freed space without deleting Morgan's files
checks.pass: You freed space from temporary and system files and left the Downloads folder alone.
checks.fail: You deleted the Downloads folder in Disk Cleanup, which held Morgan's client drawings. Temporary files and previous update files alone free enough space.

checks.practice: Software came from a safe source
checks.label: Installed from the company portal and never ran the unknown installer
checks.pass: PlanPro came from the approved portal, and the downloaded installer was never run.
checks.fail: Either PlanPro was not installed, or the installer from the unknown publisher was run. That file was not from the vendor and added unwanted programs; only the company portal is approved.

checks.practice: The edition installed meets the user's needs
checks.label: Installed PlanPro Design 2026 (64-bit)
checks.pass: The 64-bit full edition can create and edit drawings and use all 16 GB of memory.
checks.fail: The wrong edition is installed, or none. The Viewer cannot edit drawings, and the 32-bit edition is limited to 4 GB of memory. This 64-bit PC needs the 64-bit edition.

checks.practice: Confirmed the app works after the last change
checks.label: Opened a sample drawing successfully after the last change
checks.pass: PlanPro opened a sample drawing after your final change.
checks.fail: You did not open a sample drawing in PlanPro successfully after your last change.

checks.practice: The user knows what to do next time
checks.label: Explained the risk and the approved source to Morgan
checks.pass: You explained why the download was risky, where software comes from and where to keep files.
checks.fail: Morgan was not given useful guidance. Explain the risk of the download site and the approved source, without being vague or scolding.
